description: A concise, mention-only OpenAI assistant with bounded same-channel context and server-aware identities.
install_msg: Set the key privately with `[p]set api openai api_key,YOUR_OPENAI_API_KEY`, then load the cog. See `[p]help askgpt` and the bundled README for privacy details.
short: Mention-only OpenAI assistant with channel context.
end_user_data_statement: When tagged, this cog sends the request, bounded recent same-channel message context, relevant Discord identity metadata, and opted-in member profile text to OpenAI. The generateimage command sends its image prompt to OpenAI. The cog does not persist conversation messages or image prompts. It stores optional server-scoped profiles and a pseudonymization salt in Red configuration until cleared or deleted. Responses requests use store=false, though OpenAI may retain abuse-monitoring logs under its data policy.
